access_links.label: MLIT dataset metadata and download links

description: MLIT records the locations of Japan Post business premises as points, using an address list dated November 2013 and earlier public-facility records. The attributes identify each office by its official name, address, administrative area and postal-facility classification. Manager codes and public-facility categories are also documented. The provider locates addresses using Japanese address-reference information and mapping sources. These locations describe the physical nodes of the postal distribution system and can supply a historical facility inventory for logistics or accessibility simulation. The source explicitly includes temporarily closed post offices. It therefore does not establish that every recorded office was operating, or remains open today. The provider supplies GML and Shapefile metadata and download links. Access is free under the National Land Numerical Information terms; the page restricts this edition to non-commercial use. Only the catalogue metadata was reviewed. Dataset files and their current contents were not downloaded. The related parent record is the MLIT National Land Numerical Information catalogue.
